itemTypes.EQUIP: 装备: attached to an operator (max 2). 56 distinct items x (normal _a + golden _b) = 112 chess entries.

maxEquipPerOperator.source: PRTS 卫戍协议/帮助 "每名干员最多可佩戴2件装备"; arknights.wiki.gg; 变形同构体 text "由另一件携带装备而定"

rules.equipTargets: Operators on the battlefield OR in hand/整备区 (下半 update ak.hypergryph.com/news/5114: "装备可直接配置在处于整备区的干员身上").
rules.lockAndRemoval: Once equipped an item is locked; it only leaves the operator when (a) the operator is promoted to elite (3->1 merge), (b) the item itself merges into golden, (c) the operator is sold -> items return to hand (overflow -> 临时手牌区). Source: PRTS/bwiki summary "除干员晋级、道具晋级、干员出售外无法取下"; in-game tip "干员晋级后已配发装备会回收至整备区，需要重新配置".
rules.replacement: Equipping a 3rd item onto an operator with 2 items starts a replacement: player picks one equipped item, which is DESTROYED; cancelable. Source: PRTS 帮助 "达到上限强行佩戴会改为替换装备", wiki.gg "the replaced one will be destroyed".

merge.rule: 2 copies of the same NORMAL item (upgradeNum=2) automatically merge into 1 golden (进阶) copy (_b). upgradeNum=100 => never merges (talent note "本装备不会合并为进阶品质"). Golden items have upgradeNum=0.
merge.countsEquipped: [ASSUMED] copies in hand AND copies equipped on operators both count; the merged golden item goes to hand (the operator slot is freed), consistent with "道具晋级" being a removal condition.

rules.consumeOnEquip: Items whose effect says "装备时销毁" are consumed instantly when dropped on an operator, never occupy a slot, and still need a valid operator target (their effect reads the target: bonds/tier/name).

shop.itemSlotsPerShopLevel: itemCount = 1 at every shop level (1-6) in all real modes (single/multi funny/normal/hard/abyss); training mode: 0 until level 5. (act1 season: items only from shop level 5.)
shop.eligiblePool: [ASSUMED] non-hidden normal (_a) EQUIP items with tier <= current shop level, mirroring the operator rule "仅当调度中心等级≥干员所在等阶时才可能出现". Pool size by tier: I:5 II:7 III:12 IV:12 V:9 VI:11.
shop.tierWeights: [ASSUMED] reuse the operator tier-odds table for the current shop level, then uniform among items of that tier (no per-item copy limit).
shop.price: purchasePrice of the _a entry (1-5). Golden entries all have purchasePrice=5 but never appear in the normal shop [ASSUMED]; a golden can be bought only via 整备 buff (allybuff_select_5: next bought item becomes golden).
shop.refreshFreeze: [ASSUMED] item slot is refreshed (1 fund) and frozen together with operator slots.

rules.hand: Items occupy hand (手牌区) slots like operators: 10 regular (constData.maxDeckChessCnt=10) + 5 temporary (cleared when next phase starts). Source: PRTS 卫戍协议/帮助.
rules.sell: [ASSUMED] An UNEQUIPPED item in hand can be sold for 1 fund (normal or golden). Official sources only confirm operators sell for 1 fund; if you prefer strictness, disallow item selling.
rules.stacking: [ASSUMED] Effects from two different items on one operator stack: ATK%/DEF%/HP% additive with other % buffs (final = base*(1+sum%)+flat), ASPD flat additive, damage multipliers (damage_scale) multiplicative, identical status procs roll independently. Same item (normal+golden of the same name) can coexist on one operator and both apply.

magicArts.usage: Drag onto a map tile during 休整期(prep); resolves immediately (all 3 current Arts are instant). trapDuration=0.
magicArts.limit: wiki.gg (season 1): "For Arts that affect the current round, up to two Arts may be placed at a time, and all Arts on the map are destroyed when the round ends." -> implement MAX_ACTIVE_ARTS_PER_ROUND = 2.
magicArts.range: 画卷 uses range 1-1 = [(0,0),(0,1)] (placed tile + the tile in front); others 0-1 (single tile).

freeSupply.equip_free_* (道具补给, choiceType EQUIP_FRE: Special-phase (机变阶段) choice: pick equipment for free. Community (Bahamut snA=12294): happens after rounds 2/8 (标准), 2/5/8 (险境), 2/8/10 (绝境+), alternating with bounties/tactics. [ASSUMED] offer 3 random eligible items (tier <= shop level + 1, capped at 6), pick 1.
freeSupply.artifact_paid_* (机密商店): Same choiceType EQUIP_FREE with desc "无需消耗资金，获得装备补给". [ASSUMED] offer 3 items of tier >= 4, pick 1.
freeSupply.allybuff_select_1 列装: Tactical decision: you (and teammates) get 2 random tier-I equipment (pool_equip_shop_1).
freeSupply.allybuff_select_5 整备: Your next purchased item becomes golden.

rules.bondInteraction: Victoria bond counts equipped items (per equip ATK bonus, golden counts more) and every 25 layers grants a random special hammer (pool_equip_vict = {灼燃,坚固,加速,战栗}维式重锤 [ASSUMED]). band_narant (娜仁图亚) lets Sargon skills share the carrier's items of tier <= V to the 8 surrounding allies for 60 s.
